statusHistory.note: San Francisco Bay Area Tier 1 cluster, near-batch-30 run 2026-09-07-batch-30. Sourcing and identity confirmed in a prior session (3117 16th St, Mission District, San Francisco — SF's oldest continuously operating cinema, 501(c)(3) nonprofit, active programming into December 2026): roxie.com, Wikipedia, SF Examiner (nonprofit fundraising to buy the building), Screen Slate, SF Station. No dedupe conflict with the existing Mission pin (Stray Dog) per check-duplicates.mjs. Previously blocked: roxie.com returned no fetchable og:image/hero. This session found real Wikimedia Commons photos of the actual venue (RoxieSF.jpg and 'Little Roxie theater, San Francisco' — both CC BY-SA 4.0) but both are portrait orientation (2448x3264 and 3024x4032) and fail near-illustrator's hard ~16:9 hero/card spec; no landscape Commons photo of this specific venue exists (confirmed no Commons category for it, and a same-named Roxie Theater in Los Angeles was ruled out as a different building on a different coast). Per near-illustrator's 'genuinely good photo exists but can't be used as-is' clause, called for a vector-derived illustration informed by the real marquee/signage rather than a generic substitute or a hold. heroImage set to null (schema requires either null or a valid URL, and no file exists yet) and a full ready-to-run generation prompt was written to content/photo-requests.md ('Roxie Theater — Mission District, San Francisco') for a follow-up pass to produce the actual illustration, wire in heroImage, and flip status to active with a real publishedAt. Flagging explicitly rather than silently holding indefinitely.
